QuestInfo.name: I Need to Find My Daughter 1
QuestInfo.parent: I Need to Find My Daughter
QuestInfo.0: I wonder how Bruce is doing in Henesys these days...
QuestInfo.1: I met up with Bruce in Henesys, and he had great news: He finally found his daughter!!! There was one problem, however: She seems to be suffering from amnesia, Bruce gave me a toy that his daughter played around while growing up, and asked me if I can give that to her.
QuestInfo.2: I found Ayan and gave her the toy sword.

0.0: Oh, it is you! I have great news! Great news, indeed... if you have any spare time, then ask me what exactly the great news is. I also need your help on this.

yes.0: The great news is that I have found my daughter! My assistant went to places near Perion to pick up some samples. After he got done with it, he stopped by Perion for a few, and apparently, he met a lady that eerily resembled my daughter!
yes.1: So he started talking to her, and apparently, she does not remember anything from her childhood. She's also not a tribesperson... that has got to be my daughter. It seems like she was beyond shocked when she was attacked by the mushroom monster.
yes.2: That is most likely the reason why she does not remember her childhood. Here... I want you to give her this sword for me. My daughter liked to pose as a knight while growing up.
yes.3: This toy sword was something she really enjoyed playing with. This may help her bring back the memories and remember the past. Please help me help my daughter.

no.0: It is really great news... and I would really appreciate it if you can help me out here.

1.0: Hi! What? My dad is looking for me? Are you sure about that? Because I have no idea who my dad is. I don't remember anything from my childhood.
1.1: Hey, this sword...I remember this! That's right! I was attacked by a humongous mushroom, and I just ran away as fast as I could. I guess that's how I ended up in here.

yes.0: I can't believe this! I remember everything now! Where's my dad now? Well, here's a letter for my dad. Please get this to him ASAP.

lost.0: Please don't lose it again. This is a very important item for me. Good thing my assistant picked it up from the ground. Again, please don't lose it.
